principles: Worktree authority must be deterministic: active linked worktree wins for mutable story metadata.
Promised automation should run at the documented entrypoints or fail visibly.
Reviewer gates should require durable evidence without resurrecting retired LLM roles.
Freshness checks should track semantic material changes, not incidental metadata churn.
drivers: SimCell field report shows repeated manual repair cost.
Current bugs can block DONE or create false success reports.
Fixes touch lifecycle gates, so regression tests must be narrow but explicit.

options.name: A: targeted wiring and authority guards
pros: Keeps current CLI and JSON shapes compatible
Can add smoke tasks for each regression
cons: Does not eliminate all main/worktree mirror duplication
Some legacy direct handler paths still need cautious compatibility

options.name: B: central metadata service rewrite
pros: Could unify all metadata reads and writes long-term
Removes many classes of drift by construction
cons: Too large for this bug batch
High risk of breaking existing stories and fixtures
Would delay immediate SimCell workflow relief

chosen: A: targeted wiring and authority guards
rationale: 选择 A，因为这些问题已经有明确根因和局部接线点，当前目标是快速恢复真实 workflow 可用性，同时用 smoke tests 固定行为。

preMortem.scenario: Authority guard redirects a command to the wrong linked worktree
preMortem.trigger: Story id exists in main and another registered worktree with stale metadata
preMortem.consequence: Checklist or review-pass writes still drift
preMortem.mitigation: Only resolve linked worktree by exact story branch and throw explicit cwd guidance for mutable commands when caller is outside it.

preMortem.scenario: Cluster sync mutates findings during read-only-looking validate and surprises users
preMortem.trigger: validate/finding_list scans commit messages and writes findings.json
preMortem.mitigation: Document/implement noSync for validate and keep sync idempotent; finding_list sync matches existing CLAUDE.md promise.

preMortem.scenario: Retiring channel reviewer weakens normal-channel checks
preMortem.trigger: Removing koala-review-channel from opt-in without preserving CLI gate
preMortem.consequence: Main-agent-written normal channel code slips through
preMortem.mitigation: Keep validate --channel as REVIEW→TEST preflight and improve its evidence sources instead of requiring reviewer pass.

preMortem.scenario: Relaxed evidence freshness lets stale tests through
preMortem.trigger: Material hash too broad or absent on old evidence
preMortem.consequence: Real code changes no longer force evidence refresh
preMortem.mitigation: Use materialHash when present, continue treating material tree changes as stale, and ensure new write paths add materialHash.
